changes: Before returning a saved Circle approval, look up the same attempt and verify any completed transfer.
On resuming a paid order, repair a missing receipt event without preparing another transfer.

coveredScenarios: Completed approval resume returns paid without another approval
Pending approval resume reuses the same challenge
Circle or RPC outage blocks approval reopening
Lost challenge write retains original provider idempotency key
Webhook refId settles after provider response loss without browser calls
Missing receipt event repaired on paid-order resume
Paid-order write failure recovered after transfer claim reservation

limits: Failure injection uses a simulated provider and in-memory store.
New live payment with customer checkout closed remains pending.
Existing live payment alone does not establish webhook-only settlement.
